supporting_observations.claim: The supplied workstation records show sara.ali using Edge to access Zoom around 13:42 UTC; they do not document creation of ext.rwong.
At 13:50 UTC, sara.ali ran a PowerShell command that queried logical-disk free space; the record does not show account-management activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection on DC-COP-01 was unavailable for the entire 13:20–14:20 UTC review window because of a log collection outage. The supplied workstation records therefore cannot confirm or refute the domain account creation.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was created, and the exact creation time.
Which person, account, host, or process initiated the purported account creation.
Whether ext.rwong was assigned appropriate group membership or any privileges.
Whether the activity was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-COP-01 directory and security audit events for the alert window, including account creation, group membership changes, and relevant authentication events.
Check directory audit history or account metadata for ext.rwong, including creation time, creator, enabled status, and group memberships.
Confirm with the help desk whether an ext.rwong temporary account was requested and authorized.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox was running under sara.ali on WS-SALI-01; Dropbox is not among the organization's approved services. Consider a separate review. (T118-00001, T118-00002, T118-00003)
